commands.name: m102_retention_aware_actor_coupling

decision_rule: Only return to PPO if the actor keeps M101-style reset/zero-response behavior degradation while preserving M98 braking/lateral hidden-envelope lift.
failure_criteria: normal behavior regresses versus M62 or M98
reset and zero-response ablations stop degrading behavior
M98 hidden-envelope braking or lateral lift remains negative after actor coupling
the objective adds hidden parameters, oracle labels, or planner references to the actor
hypothesis: Actor coupling needs an explicit hidden-envelope retention term or gate; action divergence alone can create behavior dependence while washing out the useful M98 response-hidden belief.
success_criteria: normal-history behavior matches or exceeds the M62/M98 shared-seed baseline
reset and zero-response ablations degrade success or clearance margin
no-action-history ablation is measured even if not required to pass
response-hidden braking and lateral envelope lift are non-negative versus reset hidden
no hidden dynamics or oracle feasibility values enter actor input
